summary.text: Matthew McLaughlin is the Democratic candidate for New Hampshire State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Denise Ricciardi after advancing from the September 8, 2026 Democratic primary.
He is a retired Naval Academy graduate who flew for the U.S. Navy and later worked as a commercial airline pilot.

paragraphs.text: McLaughlin was born in Manchester, New Hampshire, and earned a bachelor's degree from the United States Naval Academy in 1981.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 1981 to 1989, and his career experience includes work as a Navy pilot and a commercial pilot.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Bedford as the youngest of 10 children, flew the A-7 Corsair as a tactical jet pilot with three deployments aboard the USS Nimitz, and worked as a commercial airline pilot for 33 years.
McLaughlin ran for the same seat in 2024 and lost to Ricciardi in the general election, 51.5 percent to 48.4 percent.

In the 2022 survey he listed protecting a woman's right to choose, ending Education Freedom Accounts and returning public money to public schools, and increasing renewable energy as his three key messages.
